scope: First complete default CodeQL analysis (Actions, JavaScript/TypeScript and Python). Every initial result reviewed against source and SARIF; no query exclusions, blanket suppressions, artwork rewrites or weakened tests. GitHub follow-up scan and deployment receipts are separate evidence.

alerts.evidence: JSON.stringify(policy.page) serializes a repository-owned policy object into a JavaScript object expression. It is not a quote-replacement sanitizer. Quotes, backslashes and controls are escaped by JSON.stringify, and no request value is evaluated.

The interpolated CSP token is a fixed sha256 prefix plus a base64 digest of the repository navigation script, serialized by JSON.stringify into a JavaScript string literal. Neither source code nor a visitor-provided expression is concatenated at this position.
The native test generator serializes report.revision (a checked source commit) with JSON.stringify into a worker fixture. It is not raw expression interpolation or a custom code sanitizer.
The native test generator serializes report.abiSHA256 with JSON.stringify into a worker fixture. The fixture uses the verified installed renderer ABI; no request-provided code is evaluated.
The native test generator serializes the reviewed inline hash array with JSON.stringify into a worker fixture. Elements remain string literals and cannot escape the generated expression.
The isolation fixture injects only a local constant object-store key through JSON.stringify into a synthetic worker. Network inputs are read as data and never used as code.
The editor-preview fixture serializes context.snapshot with JSON.stringify. The generated worker receives a data object, not an unquoted expression.
The editor-preview fixture serializes context.rootSHA256 with JSON.stringify; the checked digest is a string literal, not code.
The editor-preview fixture serializes the delivery key with JSON.stringify. Any quote or control is escaped in the generated worker string literal.

DOMParser uses the inert image/svg+xml document. sanitizeSvg rejects DOCTYPE/ENTITY, parser errors, non-SVG namespaces, any element outside the finite shape/gradient whitelist and every attribute outside the finite allowlist. Event handlers, external/data/javascript URLs and nonlocal url() references are rejected before document.importNode. The parsed untrusted document is never attached before validation.
View links pass through relatedCardURL; edit IDs are percent-encoded in a fixed local editor path.
Related detail links are parsed and restricted to the exact owned HTTPS origin and canonical /art/slug/ path.
Original image URLs are parsed and restricted to the exact owned HTTPS page or assets origin and WebP/PDF media paths.
Download links use the same exact-origin URL validator, rejecting active schemes, credentials, nonstandard ports, query/fragment payloads and lookalike hosts.

The local-only synthetic HTTP server accepts only the regex alternatives alpha or bravo at /art/(alpha|bravo)/. The capture inserted into detail() is therefore one of two fixed words; arbitrary request markup cannot reach the HTML response.

Performance inspection recognizes browser-accepted script end-tag whitespace and attributes.
Static CSP hash extraction recognizes browser-accepted script end-tag whitespace and attributes.
IndexNow JSON-LD extraction recognizes browser-accepted script end-tag whitespace and attributes.
Module preload extraction is case-insensitive and recognizes browser-accepted closing tags.
The executable inline hash guard checks browser-accepted script end tags; adversarial mixed-case/whitespace regressions reject unreviewed code.
The static CSP regression inspects scripts with browser-accepted closing tags.
Contact browser test policy hashing uses the same browser-accepted closing-tag grammar.
Production browser CSP fixture hashing uses the same browser-accepted closing-tag grammar.
The browser verifier decodes each entity exactly once in one replacement pass.
The local verifier decodes each entity exactly once in one replacement pass.
Static search attributes decode each entity once, preserving literal nested entity text.
decode is a plain-text assertion helper in a local native content test. Stripped/decoded text is compared with accepted metadata and is never emitted as HTML.
clean is a plain-text verification helper; its output is compared against the reviewed catalog during live readback and is not rendered as markup.
plain extracts text for assertions in the local verification script. Its result never enters an HTML sink; this is not an HTML sanitizer.
The script/style removal feeds plain() and string assertions about visible branding. Nothing from this verifier is served as HTML or used to authorize content.
strip extracts heading copy for an SEO report and plain-text comparisons. It does not claim to sanitize HTML for rendering.
The extracted H1 is decoded and compared with item.title in a build audit. It is not emitted into a page.

Metadata replacement removes only tokenized script elements with the exact catalog-image-metadata ID, using source spans instead of a regex stripping pass. Raw-text tokenization now recognizes whitespace and attributes in closing tags.

The removed script/style bodies are used only to compute an IndexNow editorial change fingerprint. The cleaned fragment is never served; the original HTML remains subject to its own publication/CSP checks.

publicText removes nonpublic source regions only to collect search words. The result becomes data in the search directory; search-client.ts uses title.textContent and description.textContent, and search-suggestions.ts uses label.textContent. This is not HTML sanitization.
publicText strips source script/style/svg/noscript regions solely for search indexing. Extracted text is not executable markup, and the browser search UI assigns it with textContent.
publicText removes self-closing nonpublic source regions solely for search indexing. Its output feeds normalized search tokens and textContent-based labels, never innerHTML.
The collection-editorial decode helper removes markup to compare rendered paragraph text with the accepted catalog prose. No text produced by this assertion helper is returned as HTML.
